- **Symptom:** Plan verification timed out probing the indexed-service HTTP endpoint before assessing any rows
- **Evidence:**
  - **Tool:** verify
  - **Expected:** A bounded service-index response followed by an honest row/disposition report
  - **Actual:** Exit 2; GET http://localhost:7575/indexed?service=agentic-kit exceeded Client.Timeout awaiting headers; full task validate passed independently
  - **Repro:** At baseline ea29270 with docs/prose-hitl-priority-20261023 edits: fathom verify --service agentic-kit --plan docs/plans/inventory-evidence-review.md --plan docs/plans/agentic-engineering-uplift.md --strict

- **Fix:** not implemented. A second identical verification also exited 2. No daemon/store/configuration or gate was changed; retain the operational unknown.
- **Status:** open
- **Impact:** daemon-backed plan verification unavailable during a documentation-only priority update. Full executable validation passed independently; direct document review corrected one wording issue. The normal pre-push path uses its own scratch store; this observation makes no claim about that separate verification. No new runtime plan row is claimed complete.
